heading_en: Cap on Total Required Capital for a Single Securitization Transaction
summary_ja: 一の証券化取引で保有する証券化エクスポージャーの所要自己資本の総額を、裏付資産の所要自己資本に持分比率を乗じた額で上限とできる場合とその算式を定める。
summary_en: Allows the total required capital on securitization exposures held in one securitization transaction to be capped at the underlying assets' required capital multiplied by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company's holding ratio, and sets out the formula and cases.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company may cap the total required capital amount (meaning the amount obtained by multiplying the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the securitization exposures calculated under the provisions of Article 226-4 by 8%) of one or more securitization exposures it holds in a single securitization transaction (excluding re-securitization transactions), where those securitization exposures fall under any of the following items, at the amount obtained by multiplying the total required capital amount relating to the underlying assets of those securitization exposures (where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company is an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach and those securitization exposures fall under item (ii) or (iii), the required capital amount relating to the underlying assets calculated by deeming itself to be an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach) by that Ultimate Designated Parent Company's holding ratio (meaning the ratio obtained by dividing the notional amount of the one or more securitization exposures held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company in a tranche by the notional amount of that whole tranche; the same applies in the next paragraph). (i) A securitization exposure whose risk weight is calculated using the IRB-based method prescribed in Section 2, Subsection 2, Division 2. (ii) Where the Ultimate Designated Parent Company is the originator of that securitization transaction, a securitization exposure whose risk weight is calculated using the external-ratings-based method prescribed in Section 2, Subsection 2, Division 3 or the standardized-approach-based method prescribed in Division 5 of that Subsection. (iii) Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach that is not the originator of that securitization transaction calculates the former required capital amount for credit risk under Article 13, paragraph (1), a securitization exposure whose risk weight is calculated using the external-ratings-based method prescribed in Section 2, Subsection 2, Division 3 or the standardized-approach-based method prescribed in Division 5 of that Subsection (limited to a securitization exposure that falls under item (i) in the calculation of the new required capital amount under Article 13, paragraph (1) and to which this paragraph is applied).

The amount obtained by multiplying the total required capital amount relating to the underlying assets provided in the preceding paragraph by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company's holding ratio shall be the amount calculated by the following formula. Total exposure amount of the underlying assets × K_{P} × P K_{P} is the required capital ratio relating to the underlying assets (where the pool of underlying assets is an IRB pool, the K_{IRB} calculated under the provisions of Article 232; where it is an SA pool, the K_{SA} calculated under the provisions of Article 243; and where it is a mixed pool, the value obtained by weighted-averaging, by the exposure amount of each portion, the K_{IRB} calculated under the provisions of Article 232 for the portion of the underlying assets that satisfies all of the requirements in Article 1, item (lxxiii)(a) and (b) and the K_{SA} calculated under the provisions of Article 243 for the portion other than that portion). P is the largest of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company's holding ratios calculated for each tranche.

In the case of paragraph (1), the deduction amount relating to capital that has increased as a result of the securitization transaction and credit-enhancing interest-only strips shall not be included in the total required capital amount of the securitization exposures.
